description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams used for filtering candidate history search results within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for candidate ID, action IDs, and sorting behavior.

classes.name: CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for holding search filter parameters related to candidate history in the recruitment module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the candidate ID used as a filter.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID for filtering.

methods.name: getActionIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of action IDs used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setActionIds
methods.description: Sets the list of action IDs for filtering.
